project.name: ESP32-S3 protected loopback
project.goal: Determine whether a registered digital waveform reaches a physically separate destination node and adapt the next experiment to the evidence.

targets.label: Protected waveform path
limitations: Timing is referenced to the ESP32-S3 timebase, not an independent instrument.
The fixture supports bounded path conclusions only.

setupChecklist: Use a common ground and 3.3 V logic only.
Wire GPIO4 through 2 kΩ to the source node.
Wire GPIO5 and GPIO6 to their nodes through separate 10 kΩ resistors.
Install a removable source-to-destination jumper and a 10 kΩ destination pull-down.
interventionSafety: Power down before changing the jumper or wiring.
A human must perform and declare every physical change.

reference.description: Waveform consistency is evaluated against the ESP32-S3 timebase; no independent reference instrument is present.
